scope: Local sanitized hardening branch history, tracked/source files and final production dist; no publication
method: Configured key compared in memory; source filename/content/coordinate markers reviewed against the private local audit without retaining their values. Current history and dist scanned before documentation commit; final HEAD independently rescanned after commit. All new source-derived artifacts reviewed for neutral counts/booleans/timings only.
keyTransport: Authorization or DEV custom request headers; values not recorded
limitations: Finite exact key/private marker scans and instrumented executed workflows; not a universal arbitrary-secret detector. Explicit coordinates typed by the user are transmitted as prompt text.
